case_title: GREAT SOUTHERN XPRESS INC VS SIMCO CARPET et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY GREAT SOUTHERN XPRESS INC AS TO DEFENDANT SIMCO CARPET CARPET RIOT COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-16-1991 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 04
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT SIMCO CARPET

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GREAT SOUTHERN XPRESS INC RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SIMCO CARPET CARPET RIOT COMPANY $3,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $48.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,548.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT FILED BY DEFENDANT SIMCO CARPET HEARING SET FOR OCT-11-1991 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 03
SC MOTION DISPOSITION MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT OF OCT-11-1991, GRANTED

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GREAT SOUTHERN XPRESS INC IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SIMCO CARPET CARPET RIOT COMPANY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
